company.name: Coder
company.shortDescription: Coder provides open-source tools and an enterprise platform that makes it easier to configure, secure, and scale development environments.
company.description: Coder is an AI-native development platform that provides secure, self-hosted cloud development environments for developers and AI coding agents. It enables organizations to govern AI-assisted software development while maintaining control over infrastructure, security, and compliance. Coder helps enterprises accelerate developer onboarding, standardize workflows, and safely scale AI-powered development.
